testCases.title: Grade scale boundaries map to correct grade and grade point
steps: Call gradeFromPercent() with each boundary percentage: 80, 75, 70, 65, 60, 55, 50, 45, 40.
Call gradeFromPercent() with values just below each boundary (e.g. 79.99, 39.99).

testCases.title: Attendance mark follows stepped thresholds at 95/90/80/75 percent
steps: Compute attendance mark for attendance of 95, 90, 80, 75 and 74 percent with attendanceMax=30.

testCases.title: Best 3 of 4 quiz marks are counted and capped at quiz maximum
steps: Compute a course result with quiz marks 15, 14, 13, 10 (credit 3).
Compute a course result with quiz marks exceeding the cap (e.g. 20, 20, 20, 20).
testCases.expected: Lowest quiz (10) is dropped: quizMark = 15+14+13 = 42. When the best-3 sum exceeds quizMax (45 for credit 3), the quiz mark is capped at 45.

testCases.title: Midterm and final marks are capped at their maximums
testCases.preconditions: Grading module available. midtermMax = 25% and finalMax = 50% of total.
steps: Compute a course result (credit 3) with midterm 100 (max 75) and final 200 (max 150).
testCases.expected: midtermMark is capped at 75 and finalMark at 150; excess input marks do not inflate the total.

testCases.title: Missing marks default to zero and total is the sum of components
steps: Compute a course result with an empty marks object.
Compute a course result with partial marks and verify total = attendanceMark + quizMark + midtermMark + finalMark.
testCases.expected: Empty marks give total 0 and grade F. For partial marks the total equals the exact sum of the four component marks.

testCases.title: Perfect marks produce 100 percent and grade A+
steps: Compute a course result (credit 3) with attendance 100, all four quizzes at 15, midterm 75, final 150.
testCases.expected: total = 300 (credit×100), percent = 100, grade A+ with grade point 4.00.

testCases.title: GPA is the credit-weighted mean of grade points
steps: Call computeGpa() with [{gradePoint 4.0, credit 3}, {gradePoint 3.0, credit 1.5}].
testCases.expected: GPA = (4.0×3 + 3.0×1.5) / 4.5 = 3.6667 (weighted, not simple average).

testCases.title: GPA is null when total credits is zero
steps: Call computeGpa() with an empty array.
testCases.expected: Returns null instead of NaN or a division-by-zero error.

testCases.title: CGPA across semesters with mixed credits matches manual computation
steps: Call computeGpa() with a realistic transcript of 6 courses across two semesters with credits 3, 3, 1.5, 3, 4.5, 1.5 and varied grade points.
testCases.expected: The result equals the hand-computed weighted sum ÷ total credits to floating point precision.

testCases.title: generatePassword produces passwords of requested length from the allowed charset
steps: Call generatePassword() with no argument and with length 20, repeatedly.
Check every character against the documented charset.
testCases.expected: Default length is 12; custom length is honored; all characters come from the allowed charset; consecutive calls differ.

testCases.title: Strong password policy accepts strong passwords and rejects weak ones
steps: Test isStrongPassword() with a compliant password (lower+upper+digit+special, ≥8 chars).
Test with passwords that are too short, missing uppercase, missing digit, or missing special character.
testCases.expected: Compliant passwords return true; each weak variant returns false.

testCases.title: IUT email validation accepts only @iut-dhaka.edu addresses
steps: Test isIutEmail() with valid IUT addresses and with gmail.com, a spoofed subdomain, and an empty string.
testCases.expected: Only well-formed addresses ending exactly in @iut-dhaka.edu are accepted.

testCases.title: Login succeeds with valid admin credentials and issues a session
testCases.preconditions: App running on localhost:3000 with seeded database (admin@iut-dhaka.edu / admin123).
steps: GET /api/auth/csrf to obtain a CSRF token.
POST /api/auth/callback/credentials with the admin email and password.
Inspect response cookies and GET /api/auth/session with them.
testCases.expected: A next-auth session-token cookie is issued and the session endpoint reports the admin user with role ADMIN.

testCases.title: Login is rejected with an incorrect password
steps: POST /api/auth/callback/credentials with admin email and a wrong password.
testCases.expected: No session-token cookie is issued; authentication fails.

testCases.title: Admin users API rejects unauthenticated requests
steps: GET /api/admin/users?role=STUDENT without any session cookie.
testCases.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden; no user data is returned.

testCases.title: Admin users API returns seeded students for an admin session
testCases.preconditions: App running with seeded database; valid admin session.
steps: Log in as admin (TC-13 flow).
GET /api/admin/users?role=STUDENT with the session cookie.
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 with the seeded students, including student ID 20250001 (Nafis Reza).

testCases.title: Change-password API rejects unauthenticated requests
steps: POST /api/auth/change-password with a valid strong password but no session cookie.
testCases.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized; no password is changed.

testCases.title: Departments API returns the seeded departments
steps: GET /api/departments.
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 with at least the six seeded departments, including CSE.

testCases.title: Student results API groups courses by semester with GPA and CGPA
testCases.preconditions: Seeded student 20250001 with approved semester-1 results.
steps: Resolve the student's internal id from the database.
GET /api/student/{id}/results.
testCases.expected: Response contains semesters sorted ascending, each with courses (grade + gradePoint) and a per-semester GPA, plus currentSemester=2 and a numeric CGPA.

testCases.title: Student CGPA API matches the credit-weighted computation from stored results
testCases.preconditions: Seeded student with results in the database.
steps: Read the student's results and course credits directly from the database.
Compute the expected CGPA with the shared grading module.
GET /api/student/{id}/cgpa and compare.
testCases.expected: The API CGPA equals the independently computed credit-weighted value within 1e-9.

testCases.title: Student GPA API returns 400 when the semester parameter is missing
steps: GET /api/student/{id}/gpa without a semester query parameter.
testCases.expected: HTTP 400 with an error message; no GPA row is created.

testCases.title: Admin can create a course and enroll students in it
testCases.preconditions: App running with seeded departments, programs, teachers and students.
steps: POST /api/admin/courses with a new course (code SQA 9101, credit 3, semester 2, CSE/SWE, a seeded teacher).
POST /api/admin/courses/{id}/enroll with three seeded student ids.
Read enrollments back from the database.
testCases.expected: Course is created and exactly the three selected students are enrolled in it.

testCases.title: Saving marks as draft computes results per the grading spec and sets status DRAFT
testCases.preconditions: Test course from TC-22 with three enrolled students.
steps: POST /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results with marks for each enrollment and submit=false.
GET /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results and /results/status.
testCases.expected: Status is DRAFT. Each stored result's total, grade and gradePoint exactly match the shared grading module for the same inputs.

testCases.title: Submitting marks sets status SUBMITTED and the course appears in the admin approval queue
steps: POST /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results with the same marks and submit=true.
GET /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results/status.
GET /api/admin/results.
testCases.expected: Status is SUBMITTED and the test course is listed in the admin approval queue with status "Submitted".

testCases.title: Rejecting a submission reverts status to DRAFT and stores the rejection reason
steps: POST /api/admin/results/reject with the courseId and a reason.
GET /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results/status.
testCases.expected: Status returns to DRAFT and the stored rejectionReason equals the submitted reason. Rejecting without a reason returns HTTP 400.

testCases.title: Approving a submission sets status APPROVED and upserts the semester GPA
steps: Re-submit the marks with submit=true.
POST /api/admin/results with the courseId.
GET /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results/status and read SemesterGPA rows from the database.
testCases.expected: Status is APPROVED and a SemesterGPA row exists for each enrolled student for the course's semester, matching the grading module's computed grade points.

testCases.title: Result PDF endpoint returns a valid PDF document
steps: GET /api/teacher/courses/{id}/results/pdf?type=draft.
Inspect the response content type and leading bytes.
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/pdf and a body starting with the %PDF magic bytes, non-trivial in size.

testCases.title: Login page renders branding and the login form
steps: Open / in a browser.
Check for the heading, email input, password input, Login button and Forgot password link.
testCases.expected: "IUT Result Processing System" heading and the complete login form are visible.

testCases.title: Login with a non-IUT email is rejected client-side
steps: Open /, enter someone@gmail.com and any password, click Login.
testCases.expected: Toast "Please enter your IUT email." appears, the form is cleared and no navigation happens.

testCases.title: Login with invalid credentials shows an error toast
steps: Open /, enter admin@iut-dhaka.edu with a wrong password, click Login.
testCases.expected: Toast "Incorrect email or password" appears and the user stays on the login page.

testCases.title: Admin login redirects to the admin dashboard
steps: Open /, log in with the admin credentials.
testCases.expected: Browser is redirected to /admin and the admin dashboard renders.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated access to the admin area redirects to login
steps: Open /admin directly in a fresh browser context.
testCases.expected: The server redirects to the login page (/); no admin content is shown.

testCases.title: First-login student is forced to the change-password page
testCases.preconditions: Seeded student nafisreza@iut-dhaka.edu / Nafis*123 with mustChangePassword=true.
steps: Open /, log in with the seeded student credentials.
testCases.expected: Browser is redirected to /auth/change-password instead of the student dashboard.
